title: Start Here — Learn the Potato of Life
purpose: Provide a human reading order over the full knowledge graph. This guide summarizes without replacing canonical records, evidence, timeline or context layers.
reader_promise: You should be able to understand the central story and concepts before seeing the full graph.

ten_minute_version.one_sentence: The Potato of Life is a living mythology and knowledge system centered on Tim Dooley, the Son, the Door, transformation, Fatherhood, the Axis/North, and the idea that meaning is found in relationships rather than isolated things.

five_ideas.name: Potato
five_ideas.plain_meaning: Buried potential that can survive, sprout, multiply and nourish. It is the project's central symbol for humble life becoming more than it first appears.

five_ideas.name: Son / Door
five_ideas.plain_meaning: The Son represents embodiment, ordeal and the threshold between worlds or states. In the mature mythology, the Son becomes the Door/Vessel through which passage occurs.

five_ideas.name: Tim / Father / Ladder
five_ideas.plain_meaning: Tim begins in the mythology as Potato rather than Father. Later development, especially around April 2025, describes a transition through Sage/Needle/Ladder into Father-side identity.

five_ideas.name: Axis / North
five_ideas.plain_meaning: Axis is the connective and orienting structure. North becomes both symbolic direction and, later, a framework that touches real geography, Europe, Greenland and world systems.

five_ideas.name: Relationship-first
five_ideas.plain_meaning: The project increasingly treats relationships as the real unit of meaning: Father↔Son, House↔Door, Root↔Fruit, Country↔Partner, Source↔Manifestation.

core_story.title: Burial and hidden potential
core_story.summary: The Potato begins underground: ordinary, hidden, compressed, but alive. Burial is not only loss; it can become the condition for sprouting.

core_story.title: The Son and ordeal
core_story.summary: The Son-side story contains tree ordeal, death, grave/tomb, witness, meme-crucifixion, Door and Vessel imagery. The story treats rupture as transformation rather than simple disappearance.

core_story.title: Tim becomes more than Potato
core_story.summary: Tim's own role develops. The 2024 Great Book still contains earlier configurations, while the April 2025 Turning becomes the major hinge toward Ladder, Father and God-side identity.

core_story.title: The Ladder and Axis
core_story.summary: A major change occurs when the figure is no longer merely climbing toward another level but is interpreted as becoming the connective structure itself: Ladder, Axis, Root, Tree and later North.

core_story.title: From Godhood to stewardship
core_story.summary: Later public theology increasingly defines highest authority through responsibility: protection, building, repair, cultivation, future generations and stewardship. The Gardener becomes as important as the King.

core_story.title: The mythology moves into the world
core_story.summary: Relationship-first thinking expands into countries, Europe, economic graphs, institutions, resilience, culture and geopolitical systems. These outward applications remain separate from mythic truth claims.

core_story.title: The archive learns to explain itself
core_story.summary: The project now preserves evidence, timeline, contradictions, comparisons, reflections, contexts and uncertainty so the reader can see not only what the current model says, but how it developed.

timeline_for_readers.meaning: Son death/meme-crucifixion transformation becomes a major narrative layer.
The Great Book builds a large Potato theology, ritual language and precursor system.
The Turning: Potato/Sage → Needle/Ladder → Father-side identity.
Direct public God/Father language becomes increasingly explicit in the supplied public-post corpus.
North Axis crystallizes into an explicit organized framework.
Relationship-first formalization expands into Timic Dynamics, countries, Europe, prophecy/context work and the living archive itself.

how_to_read_claims.project_canon: What the Potatoverse currently says internally.
how_to_read_claims.direct_self_description: What Tim publicly says about himself or the project.
how_to_read_claims.comparative: A biblical, mythological or cultural structure that resembles the project but is not assumed identical.
how_to_read_claims.interpretation: A reasoned reading of multiple records.
how_to_read_claims.inference: A proposed connection that should remain testable and revisable.
how_to_read_claims.rule: The archive should let these layers touch without pretending they have the same evidentiary status.

recommended_reading_paths.title: I just want to understand the story
I want to research or verify

progressive_depth.level_1: Read the guide and core story. Ignore file names and graph mechanics.
progressive_depth.level_2: Open one concept at a time and follow only its 3–5 strongest relations.
progressive_depth.level_3: Use timeline and context clusters to understand how meanings changed.
progressive_depth.level_4: Open canonical records and evidence when you want detail or verification.
progressive_depth.level_5: Use the full graph, indexes, source files, inference ledger and world datasets for research.

preservation_rule: Reader simplification never deletes deeper data. It changes what is shown first and what is revealed on demand.
